descriptionChirho: To put on or wear garments or coverings (Qal active): the subject dons clothing upon themselves, including all finite verb forms (perfect, imperfect, imperative, jussive, consecutive, infinitive) in the basic stem.
Stative adjectival sense describing someone as being dressed or clothed in specific garments (Qal passive/active participles), functioning as a descriptor of state rather than an action.
Causative stem meaning to dress or clothe another person, to put garments upon someone else (Hifil all conjugations): the subject causes another to be dressed.
Intensive passive stem indicating the state of having been clothed or dressed by someone, emphasizing the completed passive result (Pual participle).
